units.source_text: “我喜欢美丽的杉林，偶尔也到这儿来。

en.t: I love beautiful cedar groves, and I sometimes come here too.

units.source_text: 但进到杉山里，这还是头一回。”

en.t: But this is the first time I have ever gone into the cedar-covered mountain itself.”

units.source_text: 千重子说着，环视了一下四周。

en.t: Chieko said this and looked around her.

units.source_text: 杉树几乎一般粗，坚挺拔立。

en.t: The cedars were almost all the same thickness, standing firm and straight.
The grove surrounded the two of them.
